stories.title: Leading the Way
stories.detail: Kirsty Kochanski & Christopher Kochanski nose in front of Anna Allsopp & Dianne Pomeroy by 0.75, nerves well and truly in play.

stories.title: Family Affair
stories.detail: The Barac household pairing Kylie Barac & Jesse Barac card 17 gross, 6 net, and no family feud yet.
